notes: docs/STATUS.md marks it running since about 10:55 UTC.
From the shared findings: tmux session train drives the run and logs go to work/train.log and work/out/job.log.
This is the main expert-router training lane, not the baseline scorer.

docs/FINDINGS.md says the rst team may run only one GPU session at a time on Forgehand.
WAIT_GPU=1 was added to let this job wait until GPU memory drops under 2 GB.

operationalNotes.label: GPU utilization notes
operationalNotes.value: Forgehand currently exposes one team-wide GPU session, so jobs queue on a single L40S card. The Bielik LoRA wave is running, the baseline scorer is queued behind a Grok 7B LoRA holder, and the standalone Modal LoRA recipe still prefers cheaper L4 or A10G GPUs.

operationalNotes.label: Credit burn
operationalNotes.value: The latest tracked number is for Modal: the two LoRA runs pushed metered usage to about $2.27 while billed spend remained $0.00 thanks to credits. AWS notes still show Activate credit remaining, but the team's AWS path is operationally suspended and not the active lane.

operationalNotes.label: Practice score interpretation
operationalNotes.value: The tuned harness is legitimately at 15/15 on practice, but the honest bare base is much lower. This matters for any progress story shown to judges or teammates.

operationalNotes.label: Image ceiling
operationalNotes.value: The eval-set notes say 85 of 154 history items need images. Text-only models have a hard ceiling below 100% on the full paper unless tools or image handling close that gap.

refresh.title: Update only dashboard/status.json for normal status refreshes
refresh.summary: The page shell is static; the data file is the control plane. Other bots can add or edit cards without touching the HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
steps: Open dashboard/status.json and update the fields that changed: updatedAt, highlights, jobs, results, or operationalNotes.
Keep every value grounded in tracked repo files such as STATUS.md, docs/STATUS.md, docs/FINDINGS.md, INSIGHTS.md, or future committed results files.
Commit and push to main. GitHub Pages redeploys automatically from the dashboard/ directory workflow.
